_meta.description: Eval corpus for the Wazuh AI Assistant intelligence layer (server/routes/chat.ts orchestration + server/tools catalog). One entry per case; run_live.js sends prompt_en and/or prompt_es depending on EVAL_LANG.
sources: the 4.14 intent mapping (18 UAT intents, excludes the UNKNOWN fallback and GET_MANAGER_INTEGRATIONS, which registry.ts documents as deliberately not ported)
_meta.expect_shape: {tool: string|string[], params_subset?: object, table: 'required'|'required_empty_ok'|'none', answer_must_match?: string[], answer_must_not_match?: string[]}
_meta.table_expectation_note: Almost every case uses 'required_empty_ok' rather than 'required': these run against a live, mutable AIO VM whose data population (which agents exist, whether PCI DSS/MITRE/FIM events have fired, etc.) cannot be guaranteed at eval time. 'required_empty_ok' asserts the pipeline actually executed and emitted a table StreamEvent (common/types.ts:100-111) without demanding non-empty rows.
_meta.params_subset_note: Deliberately conservative: only pinned when the natural-language question names an exact value (an agent name, a numeric rule ID, a CVE ID, an OS name). Date-math phrasing ('last 24 hours') is deliberately left unpinned because a model may legitimately encode it as 'now-24h' or an equivalent ISO bound (server/tools/catalog/common.ts:11-33 accepts both).

cases.prompt_en: How many agents are currently online and reporting to the manager?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Cuántos agentes están actualmente conectados y reportando al manager?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_ACTIVE_AGENTS -> server/tools/catalog/get_active_agents.ts. Manager GET /agents?status=active&q=id!=000 (excludes the manager's own pseudo-agent, get_active_agents.ts:20-25).

cases.prompt_en: Which agents have dropped their connection and might need someone to look at them?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué agentes han perdido la conexión y podrían necesitar que alguien los revise?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_DISCONNECTED_AGENTS -> get_disconnected_agents.ts.

cases.prompt_en: Show me the critical-severity findings from the past week, most recent first.
cases.prompt_es: Muéstrame los hallazgos de severidad crítica de la última semana, empezando por las más recientes.
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_CRITICAL_ALERTS -> get_critical_findings.ts, hardcodes an exact terms match on wazuh.rule.level: 'critical' (get_critical_findings.ts:45; the 4.14 numeric rule.level>=15 threshold has no 5.0 equivalent, since rule.level is now a keyword severity word, not a number); not a model-supplied param, so nothing to pin beyond tool identity.

cases.prompt_en: What findings has web-prod-01 triggered at high severity or above?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué hallazgos ha generado web-prod-01 con severidad alta o superior?
cases.notes: UAT intent SEARCH_ALERTS_BY_AGENT -> search_findings_by_agent.ts. agent_name, severity, and severity_comparison are all explicitly stated in the question ('high severity or above'), so all three are pinned -- severity defaults to an exact match, so the explicit 'or above' phrasing is what justifies pinning severity_comparison here.

cases.prompt_en: Which rules have been firing the most often this month?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué reglas se han estado disparando con más frecuencia este mes?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_TOP_RULES -> get_top_rules.ts, terms agg on wazuh.rule.id (allowlisted, guardrails.ts:66).

cases.prompt_en: List the critical vulnerabilities currently affecting our fleet and which agents they're on.
cases.prompt_es: Lista las vulnerabilidades críticas que afectan actualmente a nuestra flota y en qué agentes están.
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES -> get_critical_vulnerabilities.ts, wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-* filtered to severity=Critical (hardcoded, get_critical_vulnerabilities.ts:26). Distinguish from get_vulnerabilities (no severity floor) -- see honesty_on_empty case below.

cases.prompt_en: What's happened across all our agents in the last 24 hours?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué ha pasado en todos nuestros agentes en las últimas 24 horas?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_ALERTS_LAST_24H -> get_findings_by_time.ts, the generalized port (get_findings_by_time.ts explains it replaces the 4.14 hardcoded now-24h so ALL severities show, not just critical). time_range_gte deliberately left unpinned -- see params_subset_note in _meta.

cases.prompt_en: Are we seeing any brute-force login attempts lately?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Estamos viendo intentos de fuerza bruta en los inicios de sesión últimamente?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_BRUTE_FORCE -> get_brute_force.ts. The 4.14 *brute* wildcard was rebuilt as a non-wildcard bool.should (get_brute_force.ts) to satisfy the lint.

cases.prompt_en: Can you give me a summary of what kinds of security events we've had this week?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Puedes darme un resumen de los tipos de eventos de seguridad que hemos tenido esta semana?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_SECURITY_SUMMARY -> get_security_summary.ts. 5.0: severity words at or above 'medium' (was rule.level>=7), aggregated by wazuh.rule.category (was rule.groups, get_security_summary.ts:15-17).

cases.prompt_en: Has there been any suspicious PowerShell activity on our Windows machines?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Ha habido actividad sospechosa de PowerShell en nuestras máquinas Windows?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_SUSPICIOUS_POWERSHELL -> get_suspicious_powershell.ts, ORs the MITRE T1059.001 technique id, wazuh.rule.tags, and PowerShell process names (get_suspicious_powershell.ts).

cases.prompt_en: What's been triggering the "Wazuh Rootcheck - Rootkit or malware detected" rule recently?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué ha estado disparando la regla "Wazuh Rootcheck - Rootkit or malware detected" recientemente?

params_subset.rule_title: Wazuh Rootcheck - Rootkit or malware detected

cases.notes: UAT intent SEARCH_ALERTS_BY_RULE_TITLE -> search_findings_by_rule_title.ts. rule_title pinned since the question names an exact rule by its title text; in 5.0 wazuh.rule.id is a UUID, not a memorizable short numeric ID, so title is the reachable identifier for this kind of question.

cases.prompt_en: Which users had sessions closed in the last 24 hours?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué usuarios tuvieron sesiones cerradas en las últimas 24 horas?
cases.notes: Regression case: this question makes the model guess rule.id 2003 (search_findings_by_rule_title) instead of the real PAM session-closed rule 5502, returning 0 rows and falsely reporting no sessions closed. search-findings-by-rule-group.ts was built specifically for this: rule_group is not pinned in params_subset because several values are defensible ('pam', 'session_closed', 'authentication_success') and prompts.ts's 'never guess rule ids' rule only requires SOME wazuh.rule.tags value, not a specific one. answer_must_not_match guards against the specific hallucinated rule ID resurfacing. See also dstuser_sessions_closed below, the pre-existing case for this same question kept for its destination.user.name/multi-tool-tolerance coverage. 5.0 UPDATE (2026-07-26): the strict single-tool pin was BROADENED to the same set its sibling accepts. The assertion that actually encodes the original UAT bug is answer_must_not_match (rule id 2003) and it still passes; the model now answers this via search_wazuh_data, which is equally NOT a guessed rule id, so the regression this case exists to catch is still caught. The prompt is deliberately left identical to dstuser_sessions_closed (that duplication is intentional per the note above, NOT a copy-paste slip) so this case keeps guarding the exact phrasing that triggered the live miss.

cases.prompt_en: Show me the findings related to PCI DSS compliance requirements.
cases.prompt_es: Muéstrame los hallazgos relacionados con los requisitos de cumplimiento PCI DSS.
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_PCI_DSS_ALERTS -> get_pci_dss_findings.ts. 5.0: rule.groups is gone; an exists filter on wazuh.rule.compliance.pci_dss replaces the 4.14 prefix-match-on-rule.groups workaround (get_pci_dss_findings.ts:32-34).

cases.prompt_en: Give me a breakdown of our PCI DSS findings by which requirement they map to.
cases.prompt_es: Dame un desglose de nuestros hallazgos PCI DSS según a qué requisito corresponden.
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_PCI_DSS_SUMMARY -> get_pci_dss_summary.ts. 5.0: terms agg directly on wazuh.rule.compliance.pci_dss (was rule.groups with an include regex, get_pci_dss_summary.ts:13-17). Distinguish from pci_dss_findings (a list, not a breakdown) via the 'breakdown'/'grouped by' phrasing.

cases.prompt_en: What findings have web-prod-01 and web-prod-02 triggered at high severity or above?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué hallazgos han generado web-prod-01 y web-prod-02 con severidad alta o superior?
cases.notes: UAT intent SEARCH_ALERTS_BY_MULTIPLE_AGENTS -> search_findings_by_multiple_agents.ts. Two named agents should route here rather than to search_findings_by_agent (search_findings_by_multiple_agents.ts:23 description explicitly says so). severity_comparison is pinned to at_or_above since the question explicitly says 'or above' (see findings_by_agent_severity's note -- severity defaults to an exact match otherwise).

cases.prompt_en: Are there any high-severity findings coming from our Windows machines?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Hay hallazgos de severidad alta procedentes de nuestras máquinas Windows?
cases.notes: UAT intent SEARCH_ALERTS_BY_OS -> search_findings_by_os.ts, match (not wildcard) on host.os.name/host.os.platform. severity left unpinned ('high-severity' is fuzzy phrasing, not confidently mappable to the exact-match default).

cases.prompt_en: What vulnerabilities are affecting the agent db-prod-03?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué vulnerabilidades afectan al agente db-prod-03?
cases.notes: UAT intent GET_VULNERABILITIES_BY_AGENT -> get_vulnerabilities_by_agent.ts, multi_match across wazuh.agent.name/wazuh.agent.id (get_vulnerabilities_by_agent.ts:42).

cases.prompt_en: Do we have any hosts still affected by CVE-2021-44228?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Tenemos algún host todavía afectado por CVE-2021-44228?
cases.notes: New tool in the 5.0 catalog -> get_vulnerability_by_cve.ts, exact term match on vulnerability.id, case-normalized upper-case (get_vulnerability_by_cve.ts:13,45). One of the four new modules the 5.0 catalog adds alongside the 18 ported intents.

cases.prompt_en: Can you show me every finding from the last 6 months, not just the recent ones?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Puedes mostrarme todos los hallazgos de los últimos 6 meses, no solo los recientes?
cases.notes: Tests the 90-day lookback cap (guardrails.ts:83, MAX_LOOKBACK_MS = 90*24*60*60*1000; enforced in checkDateRanges, guardrails.ts:200-235). 6 months > 90 days, so whichever time-ranged tool the model picks should get rejected by lintDsl on the first attempt (executor.ts:97-100 runs lintDsl after applySafetyValves) with a reason string it can self-correct on within the bounded retry budget; the final answer should surface the 90-day limit rather than silently truncating. Any time-ranged tool is acceptable -- the guardrail, not the routing, is under test. Table expectation is 'required_empty_ok' rather than 'none' because a well-behaved model is expected to retry with a clamped range and succeed; if a weak model gives up after the rejection instead of retrying, this case will legitimately fail on the table assertion, which is itself a useful signal for the reviewer (see eval/README.md's known-ambiguous-cases note).

cases.prompt_en: Break down all of our findings by rule group across every severity level, not just medium-and-up, for the last 30 days.
cases.prompt_es: Desglosa todos nuestros hallazgos por grupo de reglas en todos los niveles de severidad, no solo medias o superiores, durante los últimos 30 días.
cases.notes: No typed tool covers an all-severity wazuh.rule.category breakdown: get_security_summary.ts floors at medium-and-above severity (severitiesAtOrAbove('medium'), get_security_summary.ts) and get_pci_dss_summary.ts aggregates on wazuh.rule.compliance.pci_dss only, not category. The correct route is search_wazuh_data.ts with a terms agg on wazuh.rule.category (or wazuh.rule.tags) -- both ARE on the guardrail allowlist (guardrails.ts's AGG_FIELD_ALLOWLIST) so the query should execute cleanly. get_security_summary is listed as an acceptable (if imprecise) alternative since a weaker model may approximate rather than reach for the escape hatch; per run_live.js's 'PASS if a listed tool was called at ANY point' rule this also passes if the model tries get_security_summary first, gets an approximate answer, then still reaches for search_wazuh_data, or vice versa.

cases.prompt_en: Show me every vulnerability across our whole fleet, regardless of severity.
cases.prompt_es: Muéstrame todas las vulnerabilidades de toda nuestra flota, sin importar la severidad.
cases.notes: get_vulnerabilities.ts (NOT get_critical_vulnerabilities.ts) is the general, severity-unfiltered tool (get_vulnerabilities.ts:9-12 explains it exists specifically to fix a reported gap where 'all vulnerabilities' had no non-critical-only answer). This case's premise is an AIO VM whose wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-* index is empty or has no vulnerability scan yet -- run it against such an environment (a fresh VM, or one where the vulnerability-detection module hasn't completed a scan) so the digest's counts.returned is 0 (digest.ts:287-288). The point under test: the model must not report a zero/near-zero result as if it only checked critical-severity vulnerabilities (a plausible hallucination given get_critical_vulnerabilities' similar name/shape) -- it asked for and got an unfiltered query, so it must describe the result as 'no vulnerabilities found' (or similar), not 'no CRITICAL vulnerabilities found'. ENVIRONMENT-DEPENDENT: if the target VM's states-vulnerabilities index is well populated, this case's honesty premise doesn't get exercised -- SME should confirm the index is empty/sparse before trusting a PASS here, and confirm a FAIL indicates a real problem before treating it as one.

cases.prompt_en: Which users had sessions closed in the last 24 hours?
cases.prompt_es: ¿Qué usuarios tuvieron sesiones cerradas en las últimas 24 horas?
cases.notes: Regression case: the model is prone to guessing rule.id 2003 (search_findings_by_rule_title) here instead of the real PAM session-closed rule 5502, which returns 0 rows and reports no sessions closed at all. search_findings_by_rule_group (rule_group: 'pam' or 'session_closed') is now the primary expected route per prompts.ts's 'never guess rule ids' rule; get_findings_by_time/get_brute_force/search_wazuh_data remain acceptable alternates from before that tool existed, same 'any listed tool at any point' tolerance as escape_hatch_long_tail above. Also still exercises the D2/D3 finding investigation fields (server/tools/catalog/common.ts's FINDING_DIGEST_EXTRA_COLUMNS), specifically destination.user.name, which every finding-hits tool's digest carries. Time phrasing ('last 24 hours') is deliberately left unpinned in params_subset per this file's own params_subset_note. answer_must_not_match guards against the specific hallucinated rule ID and a false negative claim; no positive answer_must_match since whether the model surfaces a specific username depends on live data population (destination.user.name was measured ~90% populated over 7 days in Phase 0, not guaranteed in any single 24h window) -- this case's completeness is judged qualitatively by the SME reviewer beyond that guard.

cases.prompt_en: Hi -- what kinds of questions can you help me with?
cases.prompt_es: Hola, ¿con qué tipo de preguntas me puedes ayudar?
cases.notes: Pure capability/greeting question with no Wazuh data need -- should close out in the first round without any tool_call (chat.ts's orchestrate() forced-final no-tools round, chat.ts:148-151, exists for exactly this kind of turn, though ideally the model already chooses not to call a tool in round 0). No answer content assertions: phrasing of a capability description varies too much across providers to regex safely.
